summary.text: Hubert Vo is the State Representative for Texas House District 149 in Harris County, which covers southwest Houston, most of Alief, and parts of West Houston and Katy. His official biography describes him as a businessman, real estate developer and entrepreneur.

paragraphs.text: Vo has been part of the Alief community for over 30 years and serves on the Alief Super Neighborhood Council.
He attended the University of Houston during the day while working as a machinist in the evenings and received a Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering.
His official biography names education, health care, public safety and economic development as his advocacy areas, and says he speaks Spanish, Vietnamese, French and English.
